selection_rule: Every statement by an in-scope officeholder quoted in a story published on Nov. 17 or 18, 2026 in the NPR Politics and PBS NewsHour Politics feeds, and in the White House statements and House and Senate floor speeches printed in the Nov. 17, 2026 Congressional Record, as read on Nov. 18 at about 9:06 ET, less the stories earlier pages already used. PBS NewsHour carries Associated Press reporting. Quotes under five words were left out, as were commentators' accounts of what an official said, tributes and procedural remarks. Statements are worded as the outlet reported them unless a transcript is linked; entries beginning "Reported as" are the reporter's wording.
lede: On Nov. 17 and 18, officeholders in NPR and PBS NewsHour stories, White House statements and the Congressional Record spoke about the Nov. 13 FAA ground stop and the administration's $50 billion air traffic request, President Trump's trip to Asia and his trade statements with Thailand and the Philippines, the race for Senate Democratic leader, and a Senate permitting bill.

The House floor that day was largely given to public-lands, wildlife and tribal land bills, and the Senate floor to judicial confirmations, permitting and the Dream Act. This page lists 139 statements by 30 officeholders. Checks of the factual statements are running one at a time, and the page is republished as results come in.
